submitted.rationale: Of five compositions measured across the line, index 5 (Sb 0.090) gave the highest EQE, 0.065%. The other four read 0.040–0.048%. Y-Sb oxides have wide band gaps, so photoresponse at 2.7 eV is weak everywhere. There is a peak at low Sb fraction: EQE falls on both sides of index 5.
